episodes.synopsis: Members of the Warunimal Empire stand before Pan-Taron, who pilots the Panda-Z.
episodes.title: The Strongest Warrior

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Panji prepares a delicious meal but Pan-Taron cannot eat. Meals in this world are usually batteries, but Pan-Taron has trouble with utensils.
episodes.title: Table Manners

episodes.synopsis: Today's opponent is the Super Mow Jumbo, controlled by Warunimal General Mougyu Pan-Taron unleashes his special Rocket Punch! attack!
episodes.title: Certain Death! Rocket Punch!

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Jangary, a mecha master, even after being defeated, rises up and advances to a new battle.
episodes.title: A Quiet Duel

episodes.synopsis: A beautiful moon lit the Robonimal World. The research institute was swaying for some reason.
episodes.title: The Midnight Angel

episodes.synopsis: Nature is so much different from the city. A picnic is planned. Out in nature, you cannot make any calls. If Denwan comes, though, calls can be made!
episodes.title: Payphone

episodes.synopsis: The Warunimal Empire continues to wish for conquering the world. However, Panda-Z always stands in it's way.
episodes.title: Briefing

episodes.synopsis: Ravinna was left alone outside in the heavy rain and thunder. A rescue is needed before she gets wet in the rain!
episodes.title: Rescue Mission: No Postponement for Rain (1)

episodes.synopsis: Super Mow Jumbo DX stands tall! However, this fight feels the same as the scene before that had repeated several times.
episodes.title: Wild Soldier

episodes.synopsis: Mougyu has lost the fight and is immersed in loneliness. His eternal rival, Pan-Taron, appears.
episodes.title: A New Quiet Duel (1)

episodes.synopsis: Ravinna was left behind in the rain. In order to not repeat the tragedy again, a new team will stand up: The Bear Rescue Team!
episodes.title: Rescue Mission: No Postponement for Rain (2)

episodes.synopsis: Mougyu swears to the sunset that his defeats will help him become stronger!
episodes.title: Hey, Bob...

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Jangary learns the iron rule of the fight!
episodes.title: Another Quiet Duel (2)

episodes.synopsis: A red circle is written on the calendar so the date would not be forgotten. But, what is it for? Birthday? Dinner Party?
episodes.title: Mystery Circle

episodes.synopsis: The Warunimal Empire continues to organize to conquer the world using strict rules and unbelievable leadership.
episodes.title: Friends

episodes.synopsis: Ravinna again was left out in heavy rain. This time any enemy appears! Panda-Z is being dispatched!
episodes.title: Rescue Mission: No Postponement for Rain (3)

episodes.synopsis: The breaker broke and is now surrounded by darkness. Pan-Taron, Ravinna, and Denwan begin to explore to find out the cause.
episodes.title: Poltergeist

episodes.synopsis: An extreme battle takes place between Mow Jumbo and Panda-Z. The intensity climbs as the battle leaves the ground and heads to the sky!
episodes.title: Fight of the Apocalypse

episodes.synopsis: Night... a time of love. A guy stops in front of the room of RubyRaby, the only female of the Four Generals of the Warunimal Empire.
episodes.title: Night Life

episodes.synopsis: Wolgar is sent to defeat Panda-Z! But Pan-Talon won't flinch and uses a different attack than before!
episodes.title: Destroy Panda-Z

episodes.synopsis: The longer the fight, the more damage is done to Panda-Z. There is no time for rest for the repair team!

episodes.synopsis: The fight continues,. but today is different! A female maiden has found love during the battle.

episodes.synopsis: Several shocks run through the feet. Twisting and flying, anything to dodge the shock.
episodes.title: Getaway

episodes.title: Nurse Rabinna
